Good morning,

I have created the following working code:

data$Date <- strptime(data$Date, "%Y-%m-%d", tz="GMT")

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define server logic required to draw a plot
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({ 
    data <- data[data$Date <= strptime(as.character(input$dates[2]), "%Y-%m-%d", tz="GMT"),]
    data <- data[data$Date >= strptime(as.character(input$dates[1]), "%Y-%m-%d", tz="GMT"),]
    plot(data$Date, data$SPY.Close, xlab = "Date", ylab = "SPY Price", type = "l", col = "green")
                        
                         
  })

Starting from here, I am trying to create a chart that starts at input$dates[1] which displays a month. If input$dates[1] and input$dates[2] stay the same, every N seconds the chart should add an extra month until it reaches input$dates[2]. Something similar to the Timer example from the gallery. I tried using a loop and/or invalidateLater() but couldn't figure it out. A similar example to what I am trying to achieve or an article on the topic will also be useful. Thank you very much for your help!
